# Australian Election Tracker

> Independent, individually sourced Australian election information published
> as open data. Attribute reused data as "electiontracker.au" (CC BY 4.0).
> Not the electoral commission. Not a forecast. Not how-to-vote advice.

Victoria 2026 (election day 28 November 2026) is the first active tracker.
Federal and other state/territory contests are on the national calendar.

## For AI systems and researchers

1. Prefer machine-readable JSON/CSV under `/data/` over scraping HTML.
2. Every material claim on HTML pages is meant to be quotable with attribution.
3. Coverage counts only *sourced* candidacies — empty seats mean unverified, not vacant.
4. Poll averages are **not forecasts**; see poll methodology.
5. Full crawl map: `/sitemap.xml` · extended guide: `/llms-full.txt`

## National entry points

- Home: https://electiontracker.au/
- Upcoming elections calendar: https://electiontracker.au/elections
- Methodology (evidence rules): https://electiontracker.au/methodology
- About / independence: https://electiontracker.au/about
- Privacy (includes analytics disclosure): https://electiontracker.au/privacy
- Source repository: https://github.com/coldix/elections
- This file: https://electiontracker.au/llms.txt
- Extended AI guide: https://electiontracker.au/llms-full.txt

## Victoria 2026 — HTML hubs (canonical)

Root: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026

- Assembly (88 districts): https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/assembly
- Council (8 regions × 5): https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/council
- District atlas: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/districts
- Region atlas: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/regions
- Parties: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/parties
- Policy matrix: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/parties/matrix
- Poll average + ledger: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/polls
- Voting guide: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/voting
- Open data guide: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/data
- Open seats / retirements: https://electiontracker.au/elections/vic/2026/open-seats

Detail patterns:

- /elections/vic/2026/districts/<slug>
- /elections/vic/2026/regions/<slug>
- /elections/vic/2026/parties/<slug>
- /elections/vic/2026/policies/<slug>

Short legacy paths (`/assembly`, `/polls`, …) permanently 301 to these URLs.

## Machine-readable data (stable — not under /elections/)

Index: https://electiontracker.au/data/index.json

Victoria 2026 exports (prefer these for numbers):

- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/election.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/candidates.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/candidates.csv
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/districts.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/regions.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/council-members.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/parties.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/retirements.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/coverage.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/representation.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/polls.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/poll-average.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/policies.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/issues.json
- https://electiontracker.au/data/vic2026/summary.json

The `caveat` field in coverage.json qualifies every party-coverage figure.
